country_mix: named and not testable: intersections are global only, so a per-task rate cannot be cleaned of its country blend and no reverse construction is identified
x6_reporting_rule: November is reported as corroborated by August and February, never as independent confirmation: X4 and X5 cannot reach the per-task rates

X7_none_node_variant.reason: the `none` task node carries no O*NET task text, so it has no wage and cannot enter a wage quartile: keeping it leaves D unchanged by construction.
